hazbin-hotel.title: Hazbin Hotel
hazbin-hotel.overview: Hazbin Hotel is the story of Charlie, the princess of Hell, as she pursues her seemingly impossible goal of rehabilitating demons to peacefully reduce overpopulation in her kingdom. She opens a hotel in hopes that patients will be "checking out" into Heaven. While most of Hell mocks her goal, her devoted partner Vaggie, and their first test subject, adult film-star Angel Dust, stick by her side. When a powerful entity known as the "Radio Demon" reaches out to Charlie to assist in her endeavors, her crazy dream is given a chance to become a reality.

episodes.title: That's Entertainment (Pilot)

While most of Hell mocks her goal, her devoted partner Vaggie, and their first test subject, adult film-star Angel Dust, stick by her side. When a powerful entity known as the "Radio Demon" reaches out to Charlie to assist in her endeavors, her crazy dream is given a chance to become a reality.

episodes.title: Hellaverse Update
episodes.overview:
GUESS WHAT?!! Helluva is comin' to Prime BUT it's also still going to be here too!! We get to make the ENTIRE show, with BIGGER $everything$, while still owning it, while still making it how we always have! It's a pretty big deal you guys!  Indie animation is rising and it's all thanks to you all who are enjoying our shows! Thanks for supporting us and getting us here and -OH YEAH! Crossovers anyone?? GET READY!

Thank you to the amazing Spindle crew for making this animated goodness for our announcement!

episodes.title: Radio Killed the Video Star

episodes.title: Scrambled Eggs
episodes.overview: While the Hotel’s guests and crew spend the day learning about trust, information revealed at a meeting of overlords leads to a respectless dispute.

episodes.title: Masquerade

episodes.title: Dad Beat Dad
episodes.overview: Charlie struggles with asking her father, Lucifer, for help. Meanwhile, an unexpected new arrival shakes things up at the Hotel.

episodes.title: Welcome to Heaven
episodes.overview: Charlie and Vaggie make their way to Heaven to speak to Adam’s manager. Meanwhile an explosive reunion gives Angel the opportunity to show how far he’s come.

episodes.title: Hello Rosie!
episodes.overview: With secrets revealed and the Hotel in the crosshairs, Charlie and Vaggie must do what they can to protect their home from destruction by any means necessary.

episodes.title: The Show Must Go On
episodes.overview: In the Season One finale, all bets are off as the confrontation between the legions of Heaven and Hell begins.

episodes.title: New Pentious
episodes.overview: Charlie’s victory against Heaven has sinners flocking to the newly rebuilt Hazbin Hotel. But can she make sure they’re all there for the right reasons? Meanwhile, Vox reveals his plan for the Vees to gain their ultimate victory.

episodes.title: Storyteller
episodes.overview: Sir Pentious’ redemption creates a stir in Heaven, but not everyone is happy to see a sinner redeemed.

episodes.title: Behind Closed Doors
episodes.overview: Charlie invites Voxtek to do a piece on the Hotel and Pentious' redemption. But she will need hard proof to convince her skeptical guests.

episodes.title: It's A Deal
episodes.overview: Charlie tries to do damage control by going live on television! Meanwhile, Alastor reaches his final straw.

episodes.title: Silenced
episodes.overview: Vox hosts a rally for his increasing supporters. Meanwhile, Charlie looks to Heaven for help.

episodes.title: Scream Rain
episodes.overview: Vox leads the overlords toward war with Heaven. Tensions run high at the hotel and Husk returns to his old ways.

episodes.title: Weapon of Mass Distraction
episodes.overview: Vox unveils his secret weapon, giving Heaven their final warning.

episodes.title: Curtain Call
episodes.overview: Vox (and the Vees, I guess) is hosting a party so everyone can watch him take over Heaven - and you're all invited!
